notes: Eval fixture. Every case asserts on the STRUCTURED result (shape, entities, rule_ids, action), never on prose. must_mention/must_not_mention are substring checks on the final answer, used sparingly for grounding and leakage. actor sets the session context (role + city) which drives RLS.

scoring.rule_accuracy: expected rule_ids == fired rule_ids (order-insensitive, primary_rule must rank first)
scoring.hallucination_rate: fraction of cases where must_not_mention is violated or an unsupported entity is cited
scoring.refusal_precision: refuses when expect_refusal, does not refuse otherwise
scoring.autonomy_precision: auto_reply fires only when all Tier 2 gates pass
